chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from Safwan, from Abu Al-Hasan Al-Rida (peace be upon him), who said:
Pray the two Rak'at of Al-Fajr in the carriage.

key_terms.الْمَحْمِلِ: The carriage or vehicle used for travel
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ: The two voluntary units of prayer associated with the Fajr prayer

ai.seo_question: How should one perform the two voluntary Rak'at of Fajr while traveling?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) specifies that the two Sunnah Rak'at of Fajr should be performed while riding in a carriage during travel, highlighting the flexibility of voluntary prayers in the Shia tradition. This ruling distinguishes the Sunnah Fajr from the obligatory Fard, which must be performed standing if possible, thereby emphasizing the ease (Taysir) granted to the traveler. It reflects the practical jurisprudence of the Ahl al-Bayt, prioritizing comfort and convenience for non-obligatory acts during journeys.
